mentions.name: Kavla
mentions.description: An infinite canvas that runs SQL, letting users lay out queries and their results on a canvas instead of constantly alt-tabbing between data tools. Includes a simple Titanic demo; built with tldraw and DuckDB WASM running on Cloudflare Durable Objects, currently a work in progress.
mentions.problem: Working with data involves so much alt-tabbing between tools; the author wants everything on a single canvas instead.
mentions.source_excerpt:
It's an infinite canvas that runs SQL.

I've been working with data my entire career. I feel like we need to alt+tab so much. What if we just put it all on a canvas?

Currently very WIP, but there's a simple titanic demo available!

Built with tldraw and duckdb wasm, running on cloudflare durable objects
